description: Noting that Karnataka is the first state to introduce the Global Capability Center (GCC) Policy, CM Siddaramaiah said, as a result of the progressive policies of the government, more than 550 GCCs are currently operating in the state.
body_lead: Karnataka Chief Minister Siddaramaiah on Friday announced that a technology campus called "Bangalore Robotics and AI Innovation Zone" will be set up this year. AI and Robotics Technology Park under IISC will set up this facility in collaboration with ISRO and Karnataka State Electronics Development Corporation Limited (KEONICS), he added. This is being done to further strengthen the AI sector, the chief minister said. Presenting the Karnataka Budget 2026-27, he said, a Centre of Excellence for AI will be set up at IIIT Raichur at a cost of Rs 5 crore.
